title: There is no way to withdraw the ETH paid by minters
summary: ## Proof of Concept  There is currently no possible way for the contract deployer/owner to withdraw the ETH that was paid by miners. This means that value will be stuck & lost forever. This is also the case for the `ERC721A` standard, which this project actually extends as well, but it was verified in a conversation with the developer that the `ArcanaPrime` contract is expected to be used as-is, without a need for inheritance/extension.  ## Impact  This will mean hundreds of thousands of dollars (since `MAX_SUPPLY = 10_000` and `MINT_PRICE = 0.08 ether`) will be irretrievable, essentially dryi
